queries: WITH site_totals AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), shares AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, feature_count * 1.0 / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share FROM site_totals), with_avg AS (SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, feature_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM with_avg WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share_above_average DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A site's feature count is the sum of traitcount over its scanfeatures rows. Rows with NULL traitcount are excluded, so a site with only NULL counts does not appear.

Share is the site's feature count divided by the total feature count across all sites. The average share is the mean of those shares across sites, which equals 1 divided by the number of sites. Only sites with share above this average are kept.
Shares are stored as fractions between 0 and 1 and are not rounded.

assumptions.assumption: A site's feature count is the sum of traitcount over all its scanfeatures rows. Rows with NULL traitcount are excluded, so a site with only NULL counts is not counted as a site.

A site's share is its feature count divided by the total across all sites. The average share is the mean of the per-site shares, which equals 1/(number of sites). Margin is share minus average share. Values are not rounded.
